whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Toscano Cafe & Restro,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.7★ reviews with 220+ happy patrons in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu highlights, aur interactive gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/toscano

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Toscano Cafe & Restro, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Toscano Cafe & Restro) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated ambience in Kidwaipuri. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
